# Draft:Queen of the Redwood Mountains

----
Queen of the Redwood Mountains is a 2026 romantic drama written and directed by Nic Saunders. It is inspired by the filmmaker's love of the writers of The Beat Generation. The films ensemble cast is led by Gavan O'Herlihy, Philip Lambert, Kasia Halpin, Ben Ashton and Ryan Sampson.
The story revolves around the final confession of John Anderson (played by both Gavan O'Herlihy and Philip Lambert) who recounts the story of a woman he met on a beach one day. The film deals with the themes of loss, love, redemption and creativity.
